title: Optinout+PVP
description: This Modpack boosts your fps to the max!
body:
Optinout+ is a lightweight performance optimization mod designed to improve Minecraft’s efficiency and deliver a smoother gameplay experience.

Features

* Improves overall game performance
* Reduces unnecessary overhead
* Lightweight and easy to use
* Compatible with most modpacks
* Designed for stable and reliable performance

Performance

The amount of performance improvement depends on your hardware, Minecraft version, and installed mods. During testing, Optinout+ increased performance from around 120 FPS to approximately 2500 FPS on the developer’s system with the [Recommended Settings](https://youtu.be/3ok0kqRvV9M). Actual results may vary.

Compatibility

* Lightweight and optimized
* Easy to install
* Works alongside most other mods

Feedback

If you encounter any issues or have suggestions for future updates, feel free to join the [Discord](https://discord.gg/WY2jFXqEtw)
